definitions.explanation: Short for {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}: a fabric coated with resin to look like leather. Common on product labels for bags, shoes, sofas and car seats.

examples.japanese: {合皮|ごうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{合皮|ごうひ}だ。
examples.english: This sofa isn't genuine leather but synthetic.

examples.japanese: {合皮|ごうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はがれてくること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Synthetic leather is easy to care for, but the surface can start peeling after a few years.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧: genuine leather
- ⟦フェイク→フェイク：11282_feiku⟧⟦レザー→レザー：31157_rezaa⟧: faux leather — the fashion-label word for the same material
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}{皮革|ひかく}→人工皮革：23381_jinkouhikaku⟧: artificial leather — a broader technical term

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合皮|ごうひ}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: synthetic-leather material
- {合皮|ごうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: faux-leather shoes
- {合皮|ごうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はがれる: synthetic leather peels
